events.description: A group of individuals, some wearing red vests and holding a red flag, are gathered around a city bus in a dense, agitated crowd with motion blur suggesting rapid movement and possible confrontation; the scene is consistent with collective unrest or violent group clash rather than a peaceful demonstration.
A person climbs onto the front bumper/windshield of the bus and appears to engage in physical struggle with someone inside or near the driver's area; others surround the bus and push against it.

A large crowd surrounds and confronts a stationary city bus, with multiple individuals climbing on, pushing, and gesturing aggressively toward the vehicle over an extended period; the collective behavior indicates violent unrest rather than a peaceful gathering.

A group of police officers in full riot gear (helmets, shields, batons) rapidly advance and engage with individuals on a city street, surrounding and subduing at least one person on the ground near tram tracks while a bus is stopped nearby. The scene shows coordinated aggressive movement by law enforcement against civilians, consistent with riot control operations during civil unrest.

Multiple officers in riot gear are seen surrounding and physically restraining a person who is on the ground (visible in frames f7–f11), with at least one officer appearing to strike or press down on the individual. The person on the ground shows no capacity to resist, indicating a helpless victim being subjected to force.
Multiple officers in riot gear surround and physically subdue a person on the ground in the street; the individual appears restrained and unable to resist while being acted upon by several officers.

Sustained violent group confrontation involving multiple uniformed officers in riot gear engaging with individuals on a city street, including physical takedowns, running movements, and crowd dispersal; a bus is stopped nearby and bystanders observe from sidewalks.

Multiple individuals in dark uniforms (appearing to be police) are engaged in physical struggle with one or more persons on the ground near the center of the intersection; visible grappling, pulling, and forceful restraint actions occur across frames f0–f2.

A person remains on the ground while multiple uniformed officers surround and appear to apply force (e.g., kneeling, pressing down) without apparent resistance; the individual appears restrained and helpless during this period (frames f3–f8).

Escalating group confrontation: large crowd gathers, some individuals move aggressively toward officers, officers form lines and advance, and multiple people are seen on the ground or being subdued simultaneously; chaotic movement and collective tension indicate violent unrest beyond isolated incidents (frames f5–f15).

Multiple police officers in riot gear are actively engaging and subduing a person on the ground using batons and physical restraint; the individual appears to be resisting or being forcibly taken down.
A person is on the ground while multiple officers strike or press down with batons and body weight, suggesting excessive force against a subdued or helpless individual.
Large group of police in riot gear confronting a crowd in an urban street intersection; dynamic movement, batons drawn, and physical engagements indicate violent unrest or clash between groups.

Police officers in riot gear are seen subduing and restraining a person on the ground; one officer holds the individual down while another stands with arms outstretched, suggesting control or warning. The person on the ground appears non-resisting and vulnerable.

Sustained confrontation between multiple police officers in full riot gear and a crowd of civilians in an urban street intersection; officers advance, form lines, and engage individuals, while civilians scatter or confront them. A bus is stopped nearby, and the scene shows dynamic, chaotic movement consistent with violent unrest.

A group of police officers in riot gear confronts a crowd on a city street; officers advance, some holding batons, while individuals in the crowd appear to be resisting or retreating. The scene shows dynamic movement and tension consistent with violent group unrest.

In frames f2–f5, at least one individual appears to be engaged in physical struggle with an officer—visible grappling and close contact suggest mutual physical combat, though obscured by motion and partial view.

A group of police officers in riot gear advance toward a crowd on a city street, with some officers holding batons and moving in formation; civilians are seen retreating or standing near steps, indicating collective unrest and confrontation.

In frame f4 (67.5s) and f5 (68.0s), at least one individual appears to be on the ground near officers, and in f5, an officer is positioned over a person on the pavement while others surround them—suggesting physical engagement consistent with mutual or one-sided combat. Frame f6 (68.5s) shows continued close proximity and dynamic postures indicative of ongoing physical struggle.
